reviewed_clauses.source_clause: The controlled path law for a general randomized nonanticipative history policy has a normalized initial state/action law and genuine finite-history successor kernels.
hypotheses: Arbitrary finite state/action types with legitimate measurable singleton structure; actual initial probabilities and transition kernel are nonnegative normalized finite real vectors.
HistoryPolicy.action(n,history,currentState) is an arbitrary nonnegative normalized action vector depending on the entire finite past and current state, with no stationary or state-only restriction.
Measurability of the finite countable history kernels is derived by Kernel.ofFunOfCountable; no desired trajectory law, flow equation, occupancy or return conclusion is a premise.
reviewed_clauses.per_clause_reason: The actual initial joint vector is the given initial state mass times its conditional initial action probability. The actual next joint vector multiplies the preceding state/action transition probability by the action law depending on every past coordinate and the next state. Both PMFs derive normalization by genuine finite state/action sums, and all entries are nonnegative. PMF.ofFintype and the countable-history measurable kernel produce real probability laws; the singleton theorem identifies their actual atom masses with the literal factorized step vector.
